summary: A single analog-style synthesizer for the FM-1, laid out after the microKORG, where every screen page draws the waveform, filter curve, envelope or LFO it edits. A fork of Felucca.
features: Two oscillators with ring and sync, sub oscillator, noise, wavefolder
Five filters including a driven MS20-style low-pass
Four-slot patch bay, two LFOs, poly, mono, legato and 8-voice unison
Ten arp types and a 16-step sequencer with ties, accents, slides
32 programs (25 factory); scale lock and one-key chords
Web installer, browser emulator and a USB rescue mode on OCT-
